_purpose: Exp38a: noise compression — B-tier user features merged to 2 groups. Item groups unchanged from Exp29.
_format: Top-level keys: 'user_ns_groups' and 'item_ns_groups', each mapping a group name to a list of feature ids (fids).
_usage: train.py loads this file (path given by --ns_groups_json) and converts fids into positional indices.
_note_audit: Based on feature_audit: S-tier AUC>0.53, A-tier 0.51-0.53, B-tier <=0.51. B-tier user fids compressed: 15,49,51,60,62-66,80,89,90,91,101,102,103.
_note_T: T = num_queries*num_sequences + num_ns = 1*4 + (4+4+1) = 13. d_model=64, 64%13≠0 → RankMixer ffn_only. d_model=65 would be 65%13=0.
_note_user_dense: All user dense features (fid 61/62/63/64/65/66/87/89/90/91, total_dim=918) → 4 NS tokens via dense_token_groups=4. Not configured here.
